# SEO & GEO Optimization

## When to Use
- Fixing or adding meta tags, Open Graph, Twitter Cards
- Improving structured data (JSON-LD / Schema.org)
- Updating sitemap or robots.txt
- Optimizing for AI/LLM search engines (GEO — Generative Engine Optimization)
- Reviewing per-page SEO coverage

## Architecture

### SEO Component
The SEO wrapper lives at `src/hooks/useSEO.jsx` and is imported as `Head` (not `next/head`):

```jsx
import Head from '@hooks/useSEO';

<Head title="..." description="..." img="..." keywords="..." DatoEriquesido={jsonLd}>
  <ChildComponent />
</Head>
```

**Props:**
| Prop | Type | Purpose |
|------|------|---------|
| `title` | string | Page title + `<meta name="title">` + OG/Twitter title |
| `description` | string | Meta description + Twitter description |
| `img` | string | OG image + Twitter image |
| `keywords` | string | Meta keywords (currently overridden by hardcoded list) |
| `DatoEriquesido` | string | Product JSON-LD string (only for product detail pages) |
| `url` | string | Accepted but **not used** inside the component |

**Canonical URL:** Auto-generated from `useRouter().asPath` → `https://www.lavatrastosprymium.com${asPath}`

### Structured Data
- **LocalBusiness** JSON-LD is always injected by `useSEO.jsx` on every page
- **Product** JSON-LD is generated by `src/hooks/useEriquesido.js` for product detail pages only

### Business Info (for structured data)
- **Name:** Lavatrastos Prymium
- **Type:** LocalBusiness (kitchen sinks, bidets, accessories store)
- **Location:** Guatemala
- **Currency:** GTQ (Guatemalan Quetzal)
- **Brand:** Prymium
- **Phone:** Listed in JSON-LD in useSEO.jsx
- **Website:** https://www.lavatrastosprymium.com/

### Social Profiles
- **Facebook:** https://www.facebook.com/lavatrastosprymium
- **Instagram:** https://www.instagram.com/lavatrastosprymium/
- **YouTube:** https://www.youtube.com/@lavatrastosprymium6962/shorts

## Known Issues to Fix

### Critical
1. **`og:type` is invalid** — set to `"Productos para cocina"`. Must be `website` (home), `product` (detail), or `article` (blog)
2. **`og:url` domain mismatch** — uses `lavatrastosprymium.com` (no `www.`), canonical uses `www.`
3. **No `og:description`** meta tag anywhere
4. **Duplicate GTM loading** — `react-gtm-module` in `_app.jsx` AND inline script in `useSEO.jsx`
5. **Product JSON-LD issues** — expired `priceValidUntil: "2022-01-01"`, placeholder review data, `offers.url` points to WordPress API instead of product page

### Important
6. **Blog page has zero SEO** — no Head wrapper at all
7. **`preguntas/[id]`** — no `img` prop, OG image is undefined
8. **duchas, extractores, sanitarios** share identical generic titles — need unique titles
9. **Duplicate `<meta name="keywords">`** — hardcoded list overwrites dynamic prop
10. **No `robots.txt`** — must create at `public/robots.txt`
11. **Sitemap missing pages** — `/productos`, `/blog`, `/duchas`, `/extractores`, `/sanitarios`, individual questions

### Nice to Have
12. Add `og:locale` → `es_GT`
13. Upgrade `twitter:card` to `summary_large_image` when image is available
15. Add `<link rel="preconnect">` for external domains (WordPress API, HubSpot, GTM)
16. Move HubSpot script inside `<body>` in `_document.jsx`

## GEO — AI Search Optimization

### llms.txt
The file `public/llms.txt` describes the site for AI crawlers (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews). It follows the llms.txt standard.

**Location:** `public/llms.txt` → served at `https://www.lavatrastosprymium.com/llms.txt`

**Update when:**
- Adding new product categories
- Changing business info (hours, address, phone)
- Adding new pages or sections

### FAQ Structured Data
The `/preguntas` page should include `FAQPage` Schema.org markup with each question as a `Question` entity. This is critical for appearing in Google's "People Also Ask" and AI search answers.

Current questions to include:
- ¿Qué es la condensación?
- ¿Cómo instalo los drenajes de mi lavatrastos o fregadero?
- ¿Cómo instalo mi grifo de manguera?
- ¿Cómo instalo un lavatrastos o fregadero?
- ¿Qué garantía tienen los lavatrastos o fregaderos?
- ¿Quiénes Somos?
- ¿Se puede oxidar el acero inoxidable?
- Especificación técnica
